headline_findings: The programme's scope is stated by DATE (1997-2010 Blair/Brown legislation), not as a list of instruments. That is a different and larger drafting problem than twelve named measures.
The target statutes are named ONCE in the whole thesis series, and by Littlewood rather than Starkey. Starkey assents: 'I think it is a day one thing.'
'Civil service commission' is never uttered across 287 transcripts, although WS-05 is built on CRAG 2010 Part 1. His stated target is Northcote-Trevelyan, 1854.
Bank of England independence (1998) is proposed for reversal and is in NO workstream. It sits inside his own stated date range.
Quangos attract four different dispositions in a single sentence - abandon, kill off, privatise, renationalise - which are four instruments, not one.
'Repeal the European Convention' is not an available route; a treaty is denounced, not repealed.

counts.denominator_note: 67 is the number of merged ±30s windows in Pass A after collapsing the two transcript engines. It is not a count of everything he has ever proposed.
